en.title: Scientific symposium on astronomy and timekeeping: "Welcoming the Ramadan crescent between astronomy and Sharia"
en.excerpt: The Regional Centre, with AUASS and the Jordanian Astronomical Society, organises a symposium on astronomy and timekeeping, "Welcoming the Ramadan crescent between astronomy and Sharia", on 9 April 2020.
en.body:
The UN-affiliated Regional Centre for Space Science and Technology Education for Western Asia, in cooperation with the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences and the Jordanian Astronomical Society, is organising

the scientific symposium on astronomy and timekeeping
"Welcoming the Ramadan crescent between astronomy and Sharia"

15 Sha'ban 1441 AH (9 April 2020)

at the UN-affiliated Regional Centre for Space Science and Technology Education for Western Asia.
